The core idea is to explicitly minimize the Information Bottleneck (IB) loss within the GNN's attention layers. The authors posit that by doing so, the attention mechanism will learn to focus on the most relevant features of the graph, while discarding noise or less pertinent details, thereby improving the overall robustness of the GNN.
